test_objective: Verify that card materials are non-toxic and safe for handling according to ISO standards and comply with consumer safety regulations
test_procedure:
1. Extract card materials using approved solvents
2. Prepare test samples according to ISO 10993 biocompatibility testing
3. Conduct cytotoxicity testing using standardized cell cultures
4. Evaluate results against ISO acceptance criteria
5. Document findings and issue pass/fail determination
acceptance_criteria: No toxic substances detected above permitted limits as defined in ISO 7810:2019 Section 5.1. All cytotoxicity tests must show cell viability >70%
risk_if_failed: Product unsafe for consumer use, potential health hazards, regulatory non-compliance, immediate production halt required

test_objective: Verify card resistance to acidic substances that may be encountered during normal use or handling
test_procedure:
1. Prepare test samples (minimum 3 cards)
2. Expose samples to specified acidic solution (pH 3.0) for 24 hours at 23°C
3. Remove samples and rinse with distilled water
4. Dry samples completely
5. Inspect for damage, discoloration, warpage, or delamination
6. Measure dimensional changes
7. Verify functionality if applicable (chip/magnetic stripe)
acceptance_criteria: No visible damage, discoloration, delamination, or warpage. Dimensional changes must be <0.1mm. All functional elements must remain operational
risk_if_failed: Card may degrade during normal use, compromised durability, customer complaints

test_objective: Verify that the EMV chip responds correctly to all mandatory commands and meets EMVCo electrical and protocol specifications
test_procedure:
1. Insert card into certified EMV test terminal
2. Power up chip and verify ATR (Answer To Reset)
3. Select payment application (PSE or direct)
4. Execute all mandatory EMV commands in sequence
5. Verify correct responses per EMVCo specifications
6. Test transaction scenarios (purchase, cash withdrawal)
7. Verify cryptographic functions
8. Check offline and online authentication
9. Validate data element formats
10. Document all command/response pairs
test_equipment_required: Test cards with known good responses
acceptance_criteria: All mandatory EMV commands must return correct responses per EMVCo specification. ATR must be valid. Application selection must work. Transaction processing must complete successfully. Cryptographic operations must pass
risk_if_failed: Card will be rejected at terminals, payment transactions will fail, EMVCo certification impossible, complete production failure

test_objective: Verify that magnetic stripe is encoded correctly with proper signal quality, amplitude, and data integrity meeting ISO standards
test_procedure:
1. Encode test pattern on magnetic stripe using certified encoder
2. Read stripe using calibrated magnetic reader
3. Verify data integrity on all tracks (Track 1, 2, 3 if applicable)
4. Measure signal amplitude using oscilloscope
5. Check bit error rate
6. Perform 100 consecutive reads to verify reliability
7. Measure coercivity
8. Check stripe positioning
9. Document amplitude values and error rates
acceptance_criteria: 100% read success rate over 100 consecutive reads. Signal amplitude between 150-600mV. Bit error rate <0.01%. Coercivity within specification (typically 300-4000 Oe). Data matches encoded pattern exactly
risk_if_failed: Card cannot be read at point-of-sale, ATM failures, customer complaints, high return rates
